summary: FB Financial Corporation furnished a routine Form 8-K on September 17, 2026, under Items 8.01 and 9.01, disclosing that management made an investor presentation available for meetings with investors and analysts. The attached Exhibit 99.1 is a Fixed Income Investor Presentation dated September 2026, covering forward-looking statements and general company matters. No transaction, stake, price, premium, or board recommendation is disclosed. The filing is an ordinary investor-relations communication rather than a special situation. No deal terms, advisors, or regulatory clocks are stated; no risk-arb angle applies.
